spots.name: Timișoara Orthodox Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Orthodox Cathedral, also known as the Metropolitan Cathedral, is a Romanian Orthodox church in Timișoara, in Romania. The cathedral is the seat of the Archbishopric of Timișoara and the Metropolis of Banat. It is dedicated to the Three Holy Hierarchs, Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian and John Chrysostom.

names.zh: 蒂米什瓦拉正教會大教堂

spots.name: St. George's Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The St. George Cathedral, colloquially known as the Roman Catholic Dome, is the cathedral of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Timișoara and one of the city's landmarks. The cathedral is dedicated to St. George and was built between 1736 and 1774.

spots.name: Union Square
spots.summary: Union Square, also known as Dome Square, is the oldest square in Timișoara, Romania. It was named in honor of the Romanian troops that entered Timișoara on 3 August 1919 and established the Romanian administration, thus finalizing the union of Banat with Romania.

spots.name: Huniade Castle
spots.summary: The Huniade Castle is the oldest monument in Timișoara, Romania, built between 1443 and 1447 by John Hunyadi and Paolo Santini de Duccio over the old royal castle dating from the 14th century. The castle was rebuilt by the Turkish pashas in the 17th century and by Prince Eugene of Savoy in the 18th century.

spots.name: Victory Square
spots.summary: The Victory Square, known until 1990 as the Opera Square, is the central square of Timișoara. It is the place where Timișoara was proclaimed on 20 December 1989 the first city free of communism in Romania.

spots.name: Cetate Synagogue

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cetate Synagogue is a Neolog Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on Mărășești Street in the Cetate district of Timișoara, in Timiș County, Romania. Designed by Carl Schumann in an eclectic architectural style, the synagogue was completed in 1865.

spots.name: Serbian Orthodox Cathedral in Timișoara

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathedral of the Ascension of the Lord, commonly known as the Serbian Orthodox Cathedral, is an Eastern Orthodox church located in Timișoara, Romania. It is under jurisdiction of the Eparchy of Timișoara of the Serbian Orthodox Church and serves as its cathedral church.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Cathedral of the Ascension of the Lord, Timișoara

spots.name: Liberty Square, Timișoara
spots.summary: Liberty Square, formerly known as Parade Square or Prince Eugene Square, is an urban square in Timișoara. It is the second-oldest square of the former fortress of Timișoara. It got its current name during the Hungarian Revolution of 1848–1849 when Timișoara withstood a siege by Hungarian revolutionaries.

spots.name: Baroque Palace, Timișoara

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Baroque Palace is a monumental palace in the historic centre of the Romanian city of Timișoara. One of the representative buildings of 18th-century Timișoara, the Baroque Palace today houses the city's National Museum of Art.

spots.name: Timișoara Fortress
spots.summary: Timișoara Fortress is a historical fortress in western Romania around which the town of Timișoara was built.

spots.name: Plague Column, Timișoara
spots.summary: Plague Column, also known as Holy Trinity Monument, is a Baroque monument in Timișoara's Union Square. It was placed in the central square of the city, then known as Domplatz, in 1740 as an ex voto of chamber councilor Johann Anton Deschan von Hansen.

names.fr: Colonne de la Peste de Timișoara

spots.name: Fabric New Synagogue

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Fabric Synagogue, also called the New Synagogue, is a former Neolog Jewish congregation and synagogue, located at 2 Ion Luca Caragiale Street, in the Fabric district of Timișoara, Romania.

spots.name: Theresia Bastion
spots.summary: Theresia Bastion, named after the Austrian Empress Maria Theresa, is the largest preserved piece of defensive wall of the Austrian-Hungarian fortress of Timișoara. It covers about 1.7 hectares of the city center. It was built between 1732 and 1734.

spots.name: St. Catherine Church, Timișoara

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Catherine Church is a Roman Catholic church on János Bolyai Street in the Cetate district of Timișoara. The church currently serves the Slovak Catholic community in Timișoara.

spots.name: Capitoline Wolf, Timișoara
spots.summary: Capitoline Wolf is a statue located in Timișoara's Victory Square, between the Metropolitan Cathedral and the Palace of Culture. Copy of the famous Capitoline Wolf, the statue was donated by the municipality of Rome in 1926 as a symbol of Latinity that glorifies the Roman Empire culture of that period.

spots.name: St. George Square
spots.summary: St. George Square is a small urban square in the historic center of Timișoara.

spots.name: Millennium Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Millennium Church, officially known as the Church of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen of Heaven, is the largest Roman Catholic church in Timișoara, located in the Romans' Square in the Fabric district. It was built to commemorate 1,000 years since the formation of the Hungarian state, hence its name Millennium.

spots.name: Traian Square
spots.summary: Trajan Square is a square in the center of the historic district Fabric in Timișoara. It was designed by military engineers in the 1740s and is a smaller replica of the Union Square.

spots.name: Timișoreana Brewery
spots.summary: Timișoreana Brewery is the first brewery established on the current territory of Romania, in the Fabric district of Timișoara, in 1718. The brewery is owned today by Ursus Breweries and has a technical capacity of 3.1 million hectoliters per year.

spots.name: Timișoara Garrison Command

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Garrison Command, also known as the Army House, is a historical building in the Liberty Square in Timișoara, Romania.

spots.name: House with Atlantes
spots.summary: The House with Atlantes, also known as Macri House, is a historical monument in Timișoara, Romania. It is located on an important commercial street in the historic center of the city. Its name comes from the atlantes depicted on the columns that make up the facade of the building.

spots.name: St. Mary and St. John of Nepomuk Monument
spots.summary: The St. Mary and St. John of Nepomuk Monument, often shortened as Statue of St. John of Nepomuk, is a Romanian Baroque monument in Timișoara's Liberty Square. It is one of the two plague columns built in Timișoara after the Great Plague of 1738; the other is located in the neighboring Union Square.

names.es: Monumento a Santa María y San Juan Nepomuceno

spots.name: National Museum of Banat

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The National Museum of Banat is a museum in Timișoara, Romania, headquartered in Huniade Castle. It was founded in 1872 by the Society of History and Archeology of Banat on the initiative of the prefect of the then Temes County Zsigmond Ormós. It hosts the largest collection of archeological objects in Banat.

spots.name: Banat Village Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Banat Village Museum is an open-air ethnographic museum in northeastern Timișoara, at the edge of the Green Forest.

spots.name: Romanian National Opera, Timișoara
spots.summary: The Romanian National Opera is a public opera and ballet institution in Timișoara, Romania. Subordinated to the Ministry of Culture, it is one of the four national opera companies of Romania. The Romanian National Opera was established by royal decree no. 254 of 30 March 1946, issued by King Michael I.

names.ja: ルーマニア国立歌劇場（ティミショアラ）

spots.name: Dauerbach Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Dauerbach Palace, or simply Palace, is a historic building in the center of Timișoara, Romania in Victory Square, built in 1913 in Art Nouveau style for Georg Dauerbach and designed by the architect László Székely. It is located in the part of the square known as Corso.

spots.name: Old Town Hall of Timișoara
spots.summary: The Old Town Hall is a historical monument in the Liberty Square of Timișoara, Romania.

names.fr: Ancien hôtel de ville de Timișoara

spots.name: Art Museum of Timișoara

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: Among the permanent exhibitions, here you can see the largest collection of Corneliu Baba paintings.

spots.name: Serbian Orthodox Bishop's Palace, Timișoara

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Serbian Orthodox Bishop's Palace of Timișoara is a historical building in Timișoara, Romania. The building serves as the seat of the Eparchy of Timișoara of the Serbian Orthodox Church and houses the bishop's the residence.

spots.name: Neptune Public Bath
spots.summary: The Neptune Public Bath, also known as the Neptune Palace, is a historic building in the Fabric district of Timișoara, Romania. Originally a spa, today the building hosts office spaces, a luxury restaurant and around 20 apartments in the so-called Bloc Neptun.

spots.name: Church of Saint George, Timișoara

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of Saint George is an Eastern Orthodox church located in the Fabric district of Timișoara, Romania. It is under jurisdiction of the Eparchy of Timișoara of the Serbian Orthodox Church.

spots.name: Piarist High School
spots.summary: Piarist High School is an architectural ensemble in Timișoara, originally intended for the high school established by the Piarist Order. The Secession-style ensemble, comprising a high school, a chapel church and a boarding school, was designed by László Székely and opened in 1909.

spots.name: Timișoara Palace of Culture
spots.summary: The Palace of Culture is an emblematic building in Timișoara, Romania. It hosts a number of cultural institutions, including the Romanian National Opera, the Mihai Eminescu National Theatre, the Csiky Gergely Hungarian State Theatre and the German State Theatre.

spots.name: St. Mary Square, Timișoara
spots.summary: St. Mary Square is a small square in Timișoara, located in the Iosefin district, at the intersection of 16 December 1989 Boulevard and Gheorghe Doja Street. It is part of the urban site Old Iosefin, classified as a historic monument.

spots.name: St. George Church, Timișoara

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The St. George Church was a place of worship located in today's St. George Square in Timișoara, Romania, demolished in 1914.

spots.name: Military Casino of Timișoara
spots.summary: The Military Casino, one of the oldest buildings of Timișoara, is situated on the west side of the city's Liberty Square. Its construction began in 1744 and was completed in 1775. The building eventually became a casino, although it did not start as one.

spots.name: Timișoara City Hall
spots.summary: The Timișoara City Hall is the administrative body with permanent operational activity responsible for implementing the decisions of the local council and the directives of the mayor, addressing the ongoing administrative and community matters of the municipality.

spots.name: Prince Eugene House
spots.summary: The Prince Eugene House is a historical building in Timișoara, Romania, built in 1817 on the site of the Forforosa Gate, through which Eugene of Savoy entered the Timișoara Fortress on 18 October 1716, after being conquered from the Ottomans following the 1716 siege.

spots.name: Franciscan Church, Timișoara

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Franciscan Church of Timișoara was a church located in the current Liberty Square in Timișoara, Romania, built between 1725 and 1736 and demolished in 1911.

spots.name: German State Theatre Timișoara
spots.summary: The German State Theatre Timișoara is a publicly funded German-language theatre company in Timișoara, Romania, where a German-language theatre was first mentioned in 1753. The new theatre opened in 1875, but closed again in 1899 as a result of increasing Magyarization in the then Kingdom of Hungary.

spots.name: Dicasterial Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Dicasterial Palace is a historical monument in Timișoara, Romania, which serves today as the headquarters of the local court, tribunal and court of appeal.

spots.name: Fidelity Column
spots.summary: Fidelity Column, also known as Victory Monument, is a statue located in Heroes' Cemetery of Timișoara's Lipovei district. The statue was donated to Timișoara in 1853 by Emperor Franz Joseph I as a sign of his gratitude for the resistance shown during the Hungarian Revolution and War of Independence of 1848–1849.

spots.name: Elisabetin Roman Catholic Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of the Sacred Heart of Jesus is a Roman Catholic church in the Elisabetin district of Timișoara. Located in Nicolae Bălcescu Square, the neo-Gothic church was built between 1912 and 1919 after a project by architect Károly Salkovits. Holy Masses are celebrated in German, Hungarian and Romanian.

spots.name: Misericordia Church, Timișoara

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Misericordia Church, also known as the Cetate Greek Catholic Church, is a Romanian Greek Catholic church located in Timișoara's 700 Square. Dedicated to Saint Joseph, the church belonged to the Brothers Hospitallers of Saint John of God and was built between 1748 and 1753.

names.de: Kirche der Barmherzigen Brüder an der Piața 700

spots.name: Mary Bridge, Timișoara
spots.summary: Mary Bridge, formerly Trajan Bridge and Hunyadi Bridge, is a bridge in the western Romanian city of Timișoara, crossing the Bega River. It connects the Cetate district with the Iosefin district. In the immediate vicinity are the Water Palace and the Metropolitan Cathedral.

spots.name: Iosefin Roman Catholic Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of the Nativity of Mary is a Roman Catholic church in the Iosefin district of Timișoara. It was built between 1772 and 1774 in Baroque style.

spots.name: Ștefania Palace
spots.summary: The Ștefania Palace, formerly known as Totisz Palace and popularly referred to as the House with Monkeys, is a landmark building in the Fabric district of Timișoara, a city in western Romania.

spots.name: Decebalus Bridge, Timișoara
spots.summary: The Decebalus Bridge is located in the western Romanian city of Timișoara, spanning the Bega River. It is one of three bridges in the Fabric district, linking it to the inner-city district of Cetate. The eastern end of the bridge is situated between the Neptune Baths and the entrance to Queen Marie Park.

spots.name: Virgin Mary Monument, Timișoara
spots.summary: Virgin Mary Monument is located in Timișoara's St. Mary Square and it has been there since 1906, when it was built on an older statue of Virgin Mary. The legend goes that György Dózsa has been executed there.

spots.name: Water Palace
spots.summary: The Water Palace is a historical monument in Timișoara, Romania. It is located at the entrance from the city center to the Iosefin district. Built in 1901 for the Timiș–Bega Hydro-improvement Company, between 1948 and 2007 it also housed the Timișoara CFR Regional.

spots.name: House with Iron Axle
spots.summary: The House with Iron Axle is a historical house, listed as a historical monument, in the Cetate district of Timișoara. It consists of two bodies, a 2.5-meter axle being mounted on the corner of the eastern body, hence the name.

spots.name: Fabric Greek Catholic Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of the Nativity of Mary is a Greek Catholic church in the Fabric district of Timișoara. The church was originally Roman Catholic, then from 1906 Greek Catholic, from 1948 Orthodox, and from 1991 again Greek Catholic.

spots.name: Anchor Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Anchor Palace, originally known as the Kuderlich-Sailer Palace, is a historical monument in Timișoara, Romania. It stands in the Iosefin district, at the intersection of General Ion Dragalina Boulevard and Tudor Vladimirescu Embankment, along the Bega Canal.

spots.name: Queen Marie Park
spots.summary: Queen Marie Park, previously known as Coronini Park or People's Park, is the oldest park in Timișoara, located on the right side of the Bega Canal.
